verses.text: Then I heard him call out in a loud voice, "Bring here those who are appointed to punish the city, each with a deadly weapon in his hand."

And I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man dressed in linen, with a writing case at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.
Then the glory of the God of Israel rose from above the cherub, where it had been, and moved to the doorway of the temple. He called to the man dressed in linen who had the writing case at his side.
The LORD said to him, "Go throughout the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of the people who groan and weep over all the disgusting things being done in it."
As I listened, he said to the others, "Follow him through the city and kill. Do not look on them with pity or spare anyone.

Kill the old men, the young men and young women, the women and the children. But do not touch anyone who has the mark. Start at my holy place." So they began with the elders who were in front of the temple.
Then he said to them, "Make the temple unclean, and fill the courtyards with the dead. Go!" So they went out and began killing throughout the city.
While they were killing and I was left alone, I fell face down and cried out, "Oh, Lord GOD! Are you going to destroy everyone left in Israel as you pour out your fury on Jerusalem?"

He answered me, "The sin of the people of Israel and Judah is extremely great. The land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of injustice. They say, 'The LORD has abandoned the land. The LORD does not see.'
So I will not look on them with pity or spare them. I will bring down on their own heads what they have done."
Then the man dressed in linen with the writing case at his side came back and reported, "I have done what you commanded."
